tagline: LLM-ready web search and extraction for remote teammates — usage bills to your key.
requirements: Set TAVILY_API_KEY in the host environment. This is the official server from Tavily; API usage is metered to your plan.

tools.name: tavily_extract
tools.note: Fetches clean page content from URLs.

tools.name: tavily_map
tools.note: Lists the URL structure of a site.

tools.name: tavily_crawl
tools.note: Crawls site hierarchies — can consume a lot of quota.

tools.name: tavily_research
tools.note: Deep research that plans and runs many search steps; the most expensive tool on the plan.

seo.description: Share the official Tavily MCP server with MCPWire. Configure the API key on the host, let teammates search and extract web content over P2P, and keep deep research behind approval.
